Algebra 2 · Unit 7: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

Applications

Use exponential and logarithmic models: half-life, doubling time, pH, decibels.

What you’ll learn

  • Find doubling time and half-life
  • Interpret logarithmic scales
  • Fit exponential models to data
  • Calculate sound intensity levels in decibels

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 2: Exponential Growth and Decay

Suspension & Systems Lab

Model a shock’s shrinking rebound peaks as a geometric sequence and a continuous e-based envelope, forecast a trail festival’s registrations, and use logarithms, log properties and change of base to decode decibels and solve for time.

Level
Intermediate to Advanced
Time
20-25 min
  • 3 missions
  • Suspension decay simulator
  • Event growth simulator and target calculator
  • Decibel analyzer and logarithm workbench
  • Final Engineering Report (12)
  • Optional advanced engineering bench

Practices here: Fit exponential models to data; Find doubling time and half-life; Calculate sound intensity levels in decibels; Interpret logarithmic scales
